decisions.label: Cooldown trail (dots)
decisions.note: On (Ed, 2026-11-03): behind her trail's buffer, a section of pixel dots for each dodge's worth of the shared cooldown, each its own colour, the tail's dots going one at a time; each section showing is a dodge not ready, only the buffer means all ready. Off: the smooth trail exactly as before.

decisions.label: Dot size (px)
decisions.note: Each dot's size in the picture's pixels (1: Ed's "a single pixel").

decisions.label: Gap (px)
decisions.note: The gap between dots in the picture's pixels (1: "with a single pixel gap between").

decisions.label: Section length (s × top speed)
decisions.note: A section's length: this many seconds times her top speed now (about 6.7 m on the ground, 17 m over the treetops on a bare broom; longer with speed buffs). Each still drains in a dodge's cooldown.

decisions.label: Take-off ring
decisions.note: Where her dodges' room lets a take-off go before the counter's empty, a small ring where the tail must drain to, shown while the take-off is locked.

decisions.label: Halo under the dots
decisions.note: The faint halo of each section's colour under its dots (0 none).

decisions.label: Dot glow
decisions.note: Each dot's soft glow (Ed: "these dots should glow a little"; 0 none). Strong merges the dots into a line.

decisions.label: Dot glow size (px)
decisions.note: Each dot's glow, the picture's pixels across.

decisions.label: Default colours
decisions.note: The section colours of a witch who hasn't chosen her own at the Broom station's Trail row (config/trail-colours.json).
